generation.scope: On the nondegenerate thin chart with separable projective determinant quadratics (or both genuinely quadratic), every additional pairing is exactly one of four explicit sheets at lambda=+/-1,+/-1/z. Two are bisymmetric and the other two are Klein cocycle twists, giving an AS decision on all four. The quartic center lifts over the function field of an explicit elliptic parameter curve, yielding one open of regular closed fibers. Up to 32 affine character permutations decide unmarked indexed isomorphism on the generic full-rank chart.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed bilinear projective comparison at finite and infinite simple roots, eigenvalue factors, the four representations and twist equivalence, elliptic function-field exactness and the common affine character action.

mathematical_computation.scope: Symbolic transfer of even and odd factors, cocycle tensor signs, graph presentation against the rank-six Gram matrices, and quartic center ranks over the exact quadratic elliptic function field.

open_mathematics: Study unrestricted deformations at the rational rank-ten and rank-sixteen points; compute orbit-normal tangents and primary obstructions, then seek full-dimensional actual components or a finite obstruction. Address identically zero determinant quadratics and singular cross blocks outside the present chart.
